What if your crush could hear EVERY naughty thought in your head?
Imagine sitting right next to your crush.
You smile and say, "Hey, how's your day?"
But inside your head, you're screaming...
"OH MY GOD! SHE'S SO CUTE!"
Suddenly, she turns around and smiles.
Wait... DID SHE HEAR THAT?!
You panic.
"Okay, don't think anything embarrassing. Just act normal."
But your brain has other plans.
"What if I kissed her right now?"
She raises an eyebrow.
"EXCUSE ME?!"
Your face turns bright red.
You desperately start thinking about pizza... dinosaurs... ANYTHING!
But then she leans closer and whispers...
"You know... I've been thinking the same thing."
Your heart skips a beat.
"WAIT... YOU LIKE ME TOO?!"
She bursts out laughing.
"NO, SILLY! I WAS THINKING ABOUT PIZZA!"
But seriously... What if YOUR crush could hear your thoughts? Would you survive five minutes?
